Let \(t=\frac{b}{a}>0\). Then

\[
\left(\frac{3}{a}+\frac{1}{b}\right)(3a+b)
=10+3\left(\frac{b}{a}+\frac{a}{b}\right)
=10+3\left(t+\frac1t\right).
\]

Since \(t+\frac1t\ge 2\), the minimum value is

\[
10+3\cdot 2=16,
\]

attained at \(a=b\). Therefore \(m\) must satisfy \(m\le 16\).

\[
\boxed{16}
\]
